whoItsFor: Developers and 3D artists who want to recreate a reference image of an object or character as code-only, animation-ready Three.js models, without photogrammetry or downloaded assets.
useCases: Rebuild a reference photo of a product or weapon as a procedural Three.js model
Generate animation-ready characters with pivots, sockets, and colliders
Produce token-efficient, code-only 3D assets viewable live in the browser

requirements.runtime: Python ≥ 3.10 (stdlib tooling), Three.js, Claude Code, Codex, or OpenCode
